parameters.name: ApplicationId
parameters.description: The ID of the application on which you want to grant permissions.

parameters.name: UserIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the accounts to which you want to grant permissions. You can grant permissions to a maximum of 100 accounts at a time.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam authorize-application-to-users --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk2676xxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --user-ids user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --application-role-id app_role_mkv7rgt4ds8d8v0qtzev2mxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam AuthorizeApplicationToUsers --region cn-hangzhou --UserIds.1 user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk2676xxxx --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --ApplicationRoleId app_role_mkv7rgt4ds8d8v0qtzev2mxxxx --method POST --force
